name: Bay County Planning Commission
also: Local planning agency for unincorporated Bay County
what_it_does: Holds the first public hearing on rezonings, land-use and comprehensive plan changes, site plans and subdivisions, then recommends to the Board of County Commissioners, which makes the final decision.
records_online: Meeting dates only (County calendar). Agendas, minutes and members are not posted online; rezonings reach the County Commission's agendas after the hearing.

name: Lynn Haven Board of Adjustment
what_it_does: Hears requests for variances from the zoning code and advises the City Commission.
roster_source: Lynn Haven Board of Adjustment minutes, February 20, 2025 (roll call)
roster_note: A fifth member, Ms. Boyanov, is named by last name only in the minutes. The board last posted minutes in February 2025.
records_online: Agendas and minutes in the city's Agenda Center; meets only when there is a variance request.
